info.name: Mini Project One
info.description: Employee Management System is a web-based application that enables seamless employee data management within an organization.

request.description:
**Description:** Fetch all employee data.

**Method:** GET

**URL:** /employee

**Response Codes:**

- `200 OK` – All employee data retrieved successfully.
    
- `204 NO_CONTENT`– No employee found.

**Description:** Add new employee details.

**Method:** POST

**Data Validation:**

- Field: Employee Name | Type: String | Validation Rules: Min 3 characters, Max 30 characters
    
- Field: Employee Email | Type: String | Validation Rules: Must be a valid email format
    
- Field: Employee Salary | Type: Double | Validation Rules: Min value 1000, Max value 1000000
    

**URL:** /employee/add

**Response Codes:**

- `201 CREATED` – Employee data created successfully.
    
- `400 BAD_REQUEST`– Employee data not created.

**Description:** Update existing employee data based on the given employee ID.

**Method:** PUT

**Parameters:**

- `employeeId` (Path Variable) – Type: `String` – **Required**
    
- Employee data (Request Body) - Type: `JSON` - **Required**
    

**URL:** /employee/update/{employeeId}

**Response Codes:**

- `200 OK` – Employee data updated successfully.
    
- `404 NOT_FOUND`– Employee data not found/not updated.

**Description:** Delete employee data based on the given employee ID.

**Method:** DELETE

**Parameters:**

- `employeeId` (Path Variable) – Type: `String` – **Required**
    

**URL:** /employee/delete/{employeeId}

**Response Codes:**

- `200 OK` – Employee data deleted successfully.
    
- `404 NOT_FOUND`– Employee data not found/not deleted.

item.name: Get employee data by employee id

request.description:
**Description:** Retrieves employee details based on the given employee ID.

**Method:** GET

**Parameters:**

- `employeeId` (Path Variable) – Type: `String` – **Required**
    

**URL:** /employee/{employeeId}

**Response Codes:**

- `200 OK` – Employee data retrieved successfully.
    
- `404 NOT_FOUND` – No employee found for the given ID.

item.name: Get employee data by employee email

request.description:
**Description:** Retrieves employee details based on the given employee Email address.

**Method:** GET

**Parameters:**

- `employeeEmail` (Path Variable) – Type: `String` – **Required**
    

**URL:** /employee/search/{employeeEmail}

**Response Codes:**

- `200 OK` – Employee data retrieved successfully.
    
- `404 NOT_FOUND` – No employee found for the given Email.
